profile.headline: Controls Engineer
profile.summary: Bachelors in Industrial Technology/Applied Engineering with experience in PLC automation, CAD, CAM, FANUC robotics, mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, and facilites management.  Bilingual with excellent communication skills, strong problem solving aptitude and OSHA 30 certified.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Rochester, New York, United States · On-site

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a compressor polling proram using Trilogy PLC software
- Programmed with Basic and Ladder Logic
- Worked under supervision of lead Project Engineer
- Assisted field technicians with troubleshooting gas compressors

positions.title: Valet
positions.description:
- Led teams for special events, customer contact, collected payments and managed the valet podium
- Took orders from dispatcher to park and retrieve vehicles

positions.title: Humanitarian Aid/Maintenance Tech
positions.description:
- Maintained mechanical, plumbing, electrical, ventilation, well water supply and roofing systems
- Assisted chief engineer in maintaining ships' components including turbo diesel engines, a diesel centrifuge, three-phase 480 volt system, plumbing, diesel generators and a water desalination unit 
- Budgeted finaces for all maintenance departments
- Operated tools, including heavy equipment (front end loader, forklift, trucks, etc.) 
- Scheduled contractors for projects and distributed work orders 
- Conducted preventative and corrective maintenance on bearings, pumps, shafts and fans
- Collaborated with local government offices (immigration, customs) 
- Translated between Friend Ships CEO and Honduran authorities
